rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a lawsuit or court case.

example.english: This lawsuit has been going on for a year and still isn't over.
example.traditional: 呢單官司打咗成年，仲未完。
example.jyutping: ne1 daan1 gun1 si1 daa2 zo2 seng4 nin4 zung6 mei6 jyun4

rows.note: Use this in formal or legal language when referring to a lawsuit or litigation.

example.english: That lawsuit has entered the final trial stage.
example.traditional: 該宗訴訟已進入最後審訊階段。
example.jyutping: goi1 zung1 sou3 zung6 ji5 zeon3 jap6 zeoi3 hau6 sam2 seon3 gaai1 dyun6
